title: Proclamation No. 611, s. 2013
text:
MALACAÑAN PALACE MANILA

PROCLAMATION NO. 611

DECLARING MONDAY, 15 JULY 2013, AS A SPECIAL (NON-WORKING) DAY IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF MAUBAN, PROVINCE OF QUEZON

WHEREAS, on Monday, 15 July 2013, the Municipality of Mauban, Province of Quezon marks the celebration of the “Araw ng Mauban;”

WHEREAS, it is but fitting and proper that the people of the Municipality of Mauban, Quezon be given full opportunity to celebrate and participate in the occasion with appropriate ceremonies.

NOW, THEREFORE, I, PAQUITO N. OCHOA JR., Executive Secretary, by authority of His Excellency, BENIGNO S. AQUINO III, do hereby declare Monday, 15 July 2013, as a special (non-working) day in the Municipality of Mauban, Province of Quezon.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, I have hereunto set my hand and caused the seal of the Republic of the Philippines to be affixed.

Done in the City of Manila, this 26 th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, Two Thousand and Thirteen.

By authority of the President:

(Sgd.) PAQUITO N. OCHOA JR. Executive Secretary
